summary.en: The Hong Kong Open closed on Sunday with China taking two golds. Wang Zhiyi beat Thailand's Ratchanok Intanon in straight games in the women's singles final to defend her title, ending an eight-month title drought since the All England in March — she did not drop a game in five matches all week. In the mixed doubles final, top seeds Feng Yan-zhe and Huang Dongping lost the first game 17-21 to compatriots Jiang Zhenbang and Wei Yaxin, then took the next two 21-9 and 21-15 to also defend their title. Malaysia also won two golds, in the women's and men's doubles.

summary.en: The Atlanta Hawks rallied from 13 points down to beat the Detroit Pistons 107-97 at home in the NBA. summary.en: Racing Santander beat Real Sociedad 3-2 at El Sardinero in LaLiga Matchday 13. Moroccan striker Yassir Zabiri scored twice inside the first eight minutes, in the 6th and 8th minutes, before Mikel Oyarzabal pulled one back in first-half stoppage time and Goncalo Guedes levelled in the 60th minute. Zabiri then won a penalty in the 66th minute and Sergio Canales converted it two minutes later to restore Racing's lead. Real Sociedad, who started the day fifth, miss a chance to close on the leaders.

summary.en: Augsburg beat Mainz 3-1 at home to end a seven-match winless run in the league and claim a third win of the season. Michael Gregoritsch scored twice in the 19th and 48th minutes, either side of Juma Bah's first goal for the club in the 36th minute, while Ransford-Yeboah Königsdörffer pulled one back for Mainz in the 51st minute. Augsburg head coach Manuel Baum was sent off in the 43rd minute; Mainz have now lost their last three Bundesliga matches.

summary.en: Paris FC thrashed Angers 4-0 at home, scoring all four goals in the second half through Patrick Zabi in the 47th minute, Luca Koleosho in the 55th, Maxime Lopez in the 60th and a late Diego Coppola header. After 11 rounds, Paris FC climbed to second in Ligue 1, three points behind leaders Paris Saint-Germain and two ahead of third-placed Lille, although head coach Liam Rosenior said it was too early to get carried away. Angers are winless in six and sit second from bottom.

summary.en: The Minnesota Timberwolves beat the short-handed Memphis Grizzlies 104-95 at home, led by Jaden McDaniels with 25 points on 11-for-17 shooting, while Ayo Dosunmu added 19 and Minnesota shot a season-high 58 per cent from the field. summary.en: The Dallas Mavericks beat the Los Angeles Clippers 110-100 at home, led by Kyrie Irving with 25 points, including 12 in the fourth quarter, as Dallas closed the game on an 11-0 run. Top pick Cooper Flagg added 22 points, six rebounds and eight assists. For the Clippers, Brook Lopez scored 21 points, Rui Hachimura added 19 points and eight rebounds, and Darius Garland scored 16, but it was not enough to avoid defeat.
